column6: Traveller, traveller, say to my mother what @wON{Ugubi} says:

@wSN{Urim} is the joyful city of @wDN{Nanna}. But I sit behind the door of the chief musician's house in @wSN{Eridug}, the abundant city of @wDN{Enki}. Longing consumes me. I don't want to die because the bread is never fresh and the beer is never fresh. Send a messenger to me at once. It is urgent.
